title: Gloss Waypoint Document
description: One locator-bar entry in waypoints/. Clients older than the version that shipped the locator bar, and Bedrock viewers, are skipped.

preset.description: Named preset from this collection in presets.json; document fields override inherited values.

style.description: Vanilla default/bowtie or a namespaced style declared in glyphs waypointStyles. Custom styles require the current Gloss pack.

range.description: Blocks beyond which the client is given a bearing instead of the exact position. Zero always sends the position.

fallbackStyle.description: Vanilla style shown while the custom style or current pack is unavailable.
